data.narrative: The student implemented DB-native search with strict regex sanitization, multi-tenant scoping, and bounded pagination. They identified and resolved regex metacharacter injection vulnerabilities and pagination off-by-one boundary bugs, verifying correctness through end-to-end drills and automated unit tests.

dimension_scores.observation: Selected DB-native search over dedicated search clusters, citing lower operational complexity, immediate consistency, and zero dual-write synchronization drift.
dimension_scores.evidence: Chose DB-native search: avoided Elasticsearch infrastructure overhead and dual-write lag while indexing MongoDB collections directly.

dimension_scores.observation: Systematically reproduced regex injection using wildcard payload and isolated pagination off-by-one skip/totalPages calculation errors with a minimal failing test suite.
dimension_scores.evidence: Created failing unit test verifying that payload '.*' matched arbitrary patterns and skip=page*pageSize dropped page 1 records; verified fix in src/links/pagination.spec.ts.

dimension_scores.observation: Prevented ReDoS and wildcard filter injection by escaping special regex characters and strictly clamping pagination limits to prevent memory exhaustion.
dimension_scores.evidence: Sanitized query string with regex replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&') and clamped pageSize to [1, 100].

dimension_scores.observation: Constructed end-to-end drill scripts validating pagination boundary limits, cursor indexing, maxTimeMS timeouts, and lean projection performance.
dimension_scores.evidence: Executed scripts/drill-module-08-search.ts verifying HTTP 200 responses with exact page_size, total_pages, and sanitized query execution in under 15ms.

dimension_scores.observation: Clearly documented architectural trade-offs between full-text search indexing and Elasticsearch cluster maintenance in production systems.
dimension_scores.evidence: Detailed trade-off analysis in progress/sdf/module-08-context.md and progress/sdf/module-08-fix.md.

strengths: Sanitized user search input against regex metacharacters and ReDoS attacks.
Implemented comprehensive pagination boundary tests covering 1-based indexing, partial page remainders, and DoS page size clamping.

public_evidence.student_action: Implemented secure DB-native search and validated pagination boundary behavior with unit tests.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Escaped regex search query builder, maxTimeMS 1000 query guard, pageSize clamping [1, 100], and Jest unit tests passing 9/9.
public_evidence.proof: scripts/drill-module-08-search.ts and npm test passed with 9 tests passed across 2 suites.
public_evidence.ability: Designs resilient and secure search interfaces with robust input sanitization and resource-bounded pagination.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Demonstrates mastery of defensive query building and preventing Denial-of-Service vectors via query parameters.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Escaped regex metacharacters before passing user input to MongoDB query filter.
Clamped page sizes between 1 and 100 to prevent V8 memory exhaustion.
Configured maxTimeMS(1000) on search and count operations.

teaching_approaches.detail: Demonstrated with Jest unit tests contrasting unescaped vs escaped regex behavior.
